name: Ali Alfageeh
title: Masters Student
bio:
Ali Alfageeh’s primary area of research interest is in model-based engineering/architectural analysis with formal methods for the design, verification and validation of intelligent autonomous systems, cybersecurity, explainable AI.

Presently, he is working as a lecturer at the college of computing at Alqunfuthah, Umm Alqura University. Before that he worked as a business analyst in the healthcare sector. Also, he worked as business development and innovation analyst at Saudi Basic Industries Corporation (SABIC).
